context: This chunk presents pages 71-75 of the 2023 annual report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), operated by the Regional Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP). The report documents two key quality indicators for atrial fibrillation care: Indicator 7 measures the incidence of serious bleeding among prevalent patients using adapted ISTH criteria, while Indicator 8 measures the proportion of newly diagnosed patients receiving structured education within one year of diagnosis. The data reveals that 2.2% of prevalent atrial fibrillation patients experienced serious bleeding during the reporting period (1 July 2022 – 30 June 2023), with no significant improvement since 2018-2019 despite increased anticoagulant use. For Indicator 8, national compliance reached 34.6%, falling short of the ≥50% standard, with substantial regional and hospital-level variation across Denmark's five regions and numerous hospital units. The report includes detailed regional and hospital-specific results, treatment-specific bleeding rates for DOAC and marevan, and risk stratification data using the CHA2DS2-VASc score.
